Faction-Abilities.Mitosis: Your space docks cannot produce infantry.  At the start of the status phase, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control.

Abilities.Special: After you activate this system, you may produce up to 5 units in this system.
DEPLOY: When you would use your MITOSIS faction ability you may replace 1 of your infantry with 1 mech from your reinforcements instead.

Bioplasmosis.Ability-Desc: At the end of the status phase , you may remove any number of infantry from planets you control and place them on 1 or more planets you control in the same or adjacent systems.

Abilities.Special: After this unit is destroyed, roll 1 die.  If the result is 6 or greater, place the unit on this card.  At the start of your next turn, place each unit that is on this card on a planet you control in your home system.

Stymie.Desc: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your units: You may place 1 command token from that player's reinforcements in any non-home system. Then, return this card to the Arborec player.

Letani Ospha.Ability-Desc: ACTION: Exhaust this card and choose a player's non-fighter ship; that player may replace that ship with one from their reinforcements that costs up to 2 more than the replaced ship.

Dirzuga Rophal.Unlock-Criteria: Have 12 Ground Forces on Planets you control.
Dirzuga Rophal.Ability-Desc: After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your units that have PRODUCTION: You may produce 1 unit in that system.

Letani Miasmiala.Ability-Desc: ACTION: Produce any number of units in any number of systems that contain 1 or more of your ground forces.

Faction-Abilities.Masters of Trade: You do not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Trade" strategy card.
Faction-Abilities.Guild Ships: You can negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor.
Faction-Abilities.Arbiters: When you are negotiating a transaction, action cards can be exchanged as part of that transaction.

Abilities.Special: After you roll a die during a space combat in this system, you may spend 1 trade good to apply +1 to the result.
This planet's card may be traded as part of a transaction; if you do, move all of your units from this planet to another planet you control.

Production Biomes.Ability-Desc: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend 1 token from your strategy pool to gain 4 trade goods and choose 1 other player; that player gains 2 trade goods.

Quantum Datahub Node.Ability-Desc: At the end of the strategy phase, you may spend 1 token from your strategy pool and give another player 3 of your trade goods. If you do, give 1 of your strategy cards to that player and take 1 of their strategy cards.

Trade Convoys.Desc: ACTION: Place this card face-up in your play area. While this card is in your play area, you may negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Hacan player's units, return this card to the Hacan player.

Carth of Golden Sands.Ability-Desc: During the action phase: You may exhaust this card to gain 2 commodities or replenish another player's commodities.

Gila the Silvertongue.Ability-Desc: When you cast votes: You may spend any number of trade goods; cast 2 additional votes for each trade good spent.

Harrugh Gefhara.Ability-Desc: GALACTIC SECURITIES NET: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION: You may reduce the cost of each of your units to 0 during this use of PRODUCTION. If you do, purge this card.
